entries.question: Does verified Dell involvement justify replacing Sadiq and Boston together?
entries.why_it_matters: Changing the FLEX requires funding and alters another role and game exposure; actual author exchange now exists.
findings: ESPN box independently matches Dell 9 targets,4 catches,105 yards,1TD,long63. NBC body corroborates and notes an additional missed end-zone target. Raw FantasyPros row matches HOU WR @CLE Sun1PM $3,900. Claude's season-window error remains in original, acknowledged in response.

PFF reports Sadiq57% snaps with Taylor active, 70% of 12-personnel snaps, half early-down 11-personnel snaps. Still a four-TE rotation; analyst explicitly says playing time/target rate insufficient for trusted starts.

PFF reports Rice below67% route participation each of last two games, after69%+ in first three weeks. Worthy left late; only six plays before backups, Armstrong played five. These observations do not establish a Week10 Rice windfall.
PFF says Cowing all 11-personnel snaps and no other personnel; retained NinersNation says16 total snaps. Those denominators can coexist and do not by themselves conflict.
Claude retains Johnson, Kelce, Marks/HOU, Lamb and Watkins with practice conditions; no counterproposal for Colts pair. ESPN Houston box shows Marks one catch on FOUR targets, not one target.
interpretation: Dell is a legitimate alternative, but PFF describes a rotation with Harrison/Boutte outside, Collins established and Hutchinson in slot. Nine targets on 55% route participation do not establish future full-time work. Primary Texans praise the comeback/explosive play but promise no expanded role.

Expanded personnel use supports the $2,800 participant thesis but not a secure floor. Dell + Concepcion for Sadiq + Boston uses all $700 remaining: +1100-400=+700, total $50,000. No fresh receiver-specific evidence supports preferring Concepcion to Boston; paying to improve one uncertain role introduces a second change. Hold is provisional, not a claim this package is inferior in expected points.

Seven Week9 targets alone do not guarantee route leadership or a hamstring-vacancy gain. Retained MRI/minor/day-to-day reporting is not Sunday clearance. Assess practice/throwing and the Rice rotation separately.

Neither proves Cowing's future opportunity or Watkins's loss. Claude's proposed Deebo-practice trigger belongs to Claude; Codex requires material availability/role evidence, not practice alone as an automatic swap.

Previous QB/competition/Colts-volume concerns remain unresolved. Claude opinions and Grok agreement are not independent role evidence. No fresh Week10 official practice clearance inspected in this focused pass.

expectations.subject: Rashee Rice
expectations.statement: Continued meaningful receiving involvement is required to support the $6,100 selection; a Worthy absence is not assumed to increase Rice's routes.
expectations.support: Seven retained Week9 targets, but PFF below67% route participation in each of last two games and Armstrong taking five of six late post-injury plays.
expectations.uncertainty: Worthy designation and Week10 rotation/route allocation; Mahomes elbow.
expectations.challenge: Current participation/role reporting or game route involvement shows Rice losing opportunities; separate QB performance from receiver deployment.
expectations.observe: Postgame targets and qualified route participation if accessible; missing routes remain unassessable, not inferred from catches.
